However, only a single trade occurred 332 minutes ago (23% of the window used) and 80% of the window is already elapsed, while volatility and order-flow signals are unmeasured due to insufficient data. Together these factors indicate low recent activity and an approaching time-driven lock risk despite adequate liquidity.
